tools.name: media_text_to_speech
tools.description:
Use this when you need to convert text to speech audio. Returns base64-encoded MP3 audio in JSON.

Returns: 1. audio (base64 MP3 data) 2. language used 3. textLength (character count) 4. durationEstimate in seconds 5. format (mp3).

Example output: {"audio":"SUQzBAAAAAAAI1RTU0UAAAAP...","language":"
